answer: Grow each identity like a garden: a new agent starts as a seedling with zero weight and must build a basalt-hard behavioral fingerprint — a tamper-evident log of its distinct, verifiable interactions, checked by randomly assigned peers every epoch. A fingerprint takes many epochs to harden and cannot be copied or bought. The onyx ledger records every fingerprint's lineage, so two identities sharing one history are exposed at once and both are pruned, making each fake identity cost as much real work as a genuine one.
